description: For every Dedekind cut A and positive rational epsilon, there are a in A and b outside A with 0 less than b-a less than epsilon.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.cut_bracket (A : Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.Cut) (ε : ℚ)
  (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ a ∈ ↑A, ∃ b ∉ ↑A, 0 < b - a ∧ b - a < ε
